description: Reproduce develop CI run 33976924772 failure on OTP 27.3 / Elixir 1.17.3 using TDD in a worktree; investigate root cause, implement and validate a regression fix, obtain cold agent review before pushing a PR. Failure: DiskRaftLogProtocolTest.with_log/1 line 11 returns {:error, :incompatible_arguments}.

comments.text: Baseline: 100 repeated protocol-suite runs on OTP 28 / Elixir 1.19 did not reproduce natural timing. Deterministic regression keeps first fixture open before opening second with a different tmp_dir: fails with exact CI {:error, :incompatible_arguments} at with_log/1. OTP dets add_user compares filename; DETS close from ExUnit on_exit is a non-owner call. Fix scopes fixture table name to module + test and relies on DETS owner-exit cleanup.

Cold review completed by independent agent with no actionable findings; independently verified OTP DETS source semantics. Green: 53 protocol tests; full OTP28/Elixir1.19 suite (17 doctests, 158 properties, 2892 tests, 0 failures, 2 excluded); format, strict Credo, Dialyzer. Also 53 protocol tests pass on Elixir1.17.3 / OTP27.3.3 (available local patch, not exact CI27.3).

OTP27.3.3/Elixir1.17.3 full suite twice at seed346337: original protocol suite passes; only failure is existing bedrock-s9x TransactionBuilder 100ms DOWN timeout (2894 tests, 1 failure, 2 excluded). Disclosed in PR validation. Commit c31a3001 passed all hook checks; cold review clean.

title: Fix DiskRaftLogProtocolTest incompatible_arguments CI failure
